mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical twenty-one-period Twiggs Money Flow crossing its zero line on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks quote-volume-weighted auction-location pressure changing sign; follow the crossing direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when TMF crosses strictly above zero after being at or below zero; short when TMF crosses strictly below zero after being at or above zero
mechanism.why_distinct: TMF uses the prior close to form true-range auction boundaries, applies exponential rather than rolling-sum memory to close-location flow and exact base volume, and normalizes the two smoothed series. It is not CMF rolling pressure, a cumulative A/D oscillator, taker flow, OI, funding, a fitted outcome, a reused event, or a promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour true-range-adjusted exponentially smoothed auction-pressure sign-change clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including summed base volume and the immediately prior completed close
features.true_range_bounds: true high=max(current high, prior completed close); true low=min(current low, prior completed close)
features.adjusted_money_flow: ((close-true low)-(true high-close))/(true high-true low)*four-hour base volume; zero numerator when true range is zero
features.tmf: 21-period adjust=false EMA of adjusted money flow divided by the matching EMA of base volume; minimum 21 consecutive valid bars; zero denominator invalid
features.cross: current CMF strictly crosses zero from immediately prior valid TMF
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical true-range-adjusted exponentially smoothed money-flow zero cross under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no TMF period, volume field, true-range formula, zero line, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Colin Twiggs, canonical Twiggs Money Flow convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: 21 completed periods; true high=max(high,prior close), true low=min(low,prior close); adjusted flow=((close-true low)-(true high-close))/(true high-true low)*base volume; TMF=EMA(adjusted flow,21)/EMA(base volume,21), adjust=false; canonical zero-line direction
external_basis.selection_use: published period, formula, zero line, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
